instruments.purpose: FX regime/context research; not broker execution

candidate_sources.name: Frankfurter / ECB reference rates
candidate_sources.evidence: Frankfurter documents a free keyless API aggregating 219 currencies and 39 other assets from 112 central banks/official sources; each provider publishes once or a few times daily. Explicitly reference-only, not executable bid/ask. Pin provider (for example ECB) and retain provider/date provenance. Official docs reviewed 2026-11-16.

candidate_sources.name: Twelve Data
candidate_sources.evidence: Prior research indicated free Basic limitations; verify current plan, forex coverage, request quotas, redistribution and billing triggers before use.

candidate_sources.name: FOREX.com Canada REST API
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: broker-specific streaming prices and historical market data; trading endpoints also exist
candidate_sources.evidence: Official Canada API page describes live streaming prices, historical data and order/account endpoints. It requires opening a standard account and contacting support for API access; account funding is part of its stated workflow. CIRO dealer listing identifies GAIN Capital - FOREX.com Canada Ltd. Candidate only; no account, API access, credential, order endpoint or execution permission approved.

candidate_sources.name: OANDA Canada broker feed / v20 API
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: broker-specific FX pricing stream and historical candles; trading endpoints also exist
candidate_sources.evidence: OANDA Canada publicly offers FX instruments; OANDA v20 documentation describes real-time tradeable-pair rates and historical prices, but API use requires a compatible v20 account and acceptance of API license. The API docs contain division-availability exclusions, so Canadian-entity/account compatibility must be confirmed before any use. No account, token or execution permission approved.

candidate_sources.evidence: Canadian product navigation lists US SP 500 and the API overview describes live streaming prices and historical data across markets; API requires funded standard account and support activation. candidate_sources.endpoint_class: broker-specific index CFD stream and historical market data
candidate_sources.evidence: OANDA Canada lists US SPX 500 index CFDs and documents API access for eligible v20 accounts. No account or token approved.

instruments.purpose: gold research; separate indicative bullion spot from broker-tradable XAUUSD

candidate_sources.name: Standard Bullion API
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: indicative bullion bid/ask and historical captures
candidate_sources.evidence: Current official API page documents keyless live dealer bid/ask, 15-minute intraday history from 2026 and older daily/monthly history; attribution is mandatory and raw bulk redistribution/resale is prohibited. Indicative dealer quote, not broker XAUUSD contract quote. Public docs reviewed 2026-11-16.

candidate_sources.name: XAUS API
candidate_sources.evidence: Current public API documentation describes keyless spot endpoint and explicit data-state/age fields; the public repository states last-known prices may be returned during upstream outage. Independence of underlying upstream pricing from other APIs has not been demonstrated; not executable broker bid/ask.

candidate_sources.name: GoldPrice.dev
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: delayed spot and daily historical data
candidate_sources.evidence: Official docs dated 2026-10-20 confirm XAU-USD spot price, keyless free data delayed 15 minutes, 10 requests/minute and 100/hour per IP; free key is 5,000 requests/month and paid plans provide live prices. Intraday bars/paid data not authorized; stale flag and computed_at fields available.

candidate_sources.name: Broker XAUUSD quote stream
candidate_sources.evidence: Required for broker-specific spread, contract size, trading hours, financing/swap and execution assumptions; no account or connection approved.

candidate_sources.name: FOREX.com Canada XAUUSD / metals API
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: broker-specific metals quote stream and historical prices
candidate_sources.evidence: Canadian metals page lists XAU and says gold/silver can be traded as FX-quoted spot or CFDs referencing futures. Canada API page describes streaming prices and historical market data but requires a standard account and support activation; account funding is part of the stated workflow. No account or API access approved. Broker quote must remain distinct from bullion spot.

candidate_sources.name: OANDA Canada XAUUSD / metals feed
candidate_sources.endpoint_class: broker-specific metal CFD quotes and historical market data
candidate_sources.evidence: OANDA Canada lists gold/metals CFDs and publicly documents an API for eligible v20 accounts; API access and product/account eligibility must be confirmed for Canadian entity. CFDs and financing/holding charges create separate product and Shariah review questions. No account, token, trade or execution permission approved.

global_gaps: No source in this registry is approved for live execution.
No production source pair has passed independent-provider failover tests.
No provider has completed current terms, Canadian access, privacy and data-rights review in this build.
No XAUUSD broker feed or executable Forex/indices quote feed is connected.
No historical out-of-sample dataset has been approved for strategy validation.

Broker API candidates now have public capability evidence, but account eligibility, API license, data-use rights, symbols, rate limits, historical depth and read-only permission are not cleared; account creation/funding is outside the zero-spend scope.
Gold reference APIs are not independent broker feeds; only a broker-specific bid/ask stream with verified contract metadata can qualify as the execution-price reference for that broker.
Any CFD/financing/overnight structure requires separate Shariah review before consideration; a provider's Canadian registration does not establish halal suitability.
